name: Orange, whole (with peel, as harvested)
source: Whole citrus fruit including peel: illustrative proximate (per kg) water 830 g, protein 10 g, fat 3 g, carbohydrate 130 g, ash 27 g (USDA FoodData Central pattern for orange flesh, adjusted upward in fibre/ash for whole-fruit peel content).
notes: Standard elemental conversion factors as wheat-grain.json. Juicing (origin/citrus.ts) splits the fruit's own exact composition between orange-juice and orange-peel by splitByProfile, so their two masses always sum to exactly the whole fruit pressed.
